from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection with its title and references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers mentioned in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed results for the collection of papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
